<!--
Release notes template. Copy this file to release-notes.md when cutting a
release, fill in the sections that apply and pass the file to gh release create
via --notes-file.

Style:
- One short top paragraph that summarises the change in plain English.
- Bullets under "What changed". Use simple verbs (Fixed, Added, Improved).
- "Notes" only if a merchant has to do something after updating.
- No marketing language. UK English. No em dashes. No Oxford commas.
- Do not include credentials, customer data or live transaction ids.

The release workflow appends the SHA-256 of the built ZIP automatically, so the
verification block does not need to be added by hand.
-->

## Version X.Y.Z

One or two sentences describing what this release is for, the merchant impact and any context that helps a non-technical reader understand why it matters.

### What changed

- Fixed an issue where ...
- Added ...
- Improved ...

### Notes

No settings need to be changed after updating.
